grass: res://assets/cheerful/grass.png, repeats every 480 world units; seasonal shader tint
bridges: five independent sprites from supplied jembatan-individual assets
animation: Animated river displacement and flowing detail texture; independent moving waterfall white ribbons, foam/mist at both falls.
placement: image-based occupancy, 100x70 ground clearance, full artwork bounding rectangle checks, saved layout migration 5
limits: Base riverbanks/cliffs are raster art, not true 3D or native 4K. Extreme zoom cannot invent missing geometry detail. Mobile physical-device performance not tested.
prompt_set: Reference-based portrait Four Seasons terrain, central circular plaza, four biomes and winding rivers; no UI/characters/buildings.
Remove only five baked wooden bridges, retain riverbanks and path endpoints, preserve layout.
Replace only flat land textures with simple old-game grass style: green spring/summer, gold autumn, pale blue-white winter; preserve paths, plaza, rivers, banks, sky and mountains.

Create one huge continuous summer-green island in portrait, narrow ocean perimeter, simple plain grass, inland waterfall/lake near upper right, narrow river along right side, circular stone plaza left-center, winding paths; no bridges, trees, buildings, characters or UI. Other seasons use local ground palette, nature and regional weather.

Remove only central circular stone paving; simplify tan paths to one winding north-south main path and two short river spurs, preserving one-island silhouette, coastline, river/lake and both waterfalls. Built-in image_gen, no CLI.

regional_weather.entry: compact fade-and-slide banner with particle intensity pulse, triggered by player region, boundary debounce 0.25s
regional_weather.legacy: removed global 600-second season and 90-second weather rotation; clothing previews do not affect weather

world_design.layout: Each season is a separate full 4320x7680 world. Summer is a single large island, not a map quadrant.
world_design.unlock: All 25 districts of the previous island must be open according to its local city level. Purchases and tier 5 upgrades are optional for travel.
world_design.persistence: District ownership, upgrades, cooldowns, decorations, tree clearing, resource nodes, placements, roads, and city XP are saved per island. Farmer level, inventory/currencies, animals, crops, and core farm facilities remain shared.
world_design.camera: Main draw commands refresh for every changed camera transform. Background synchronizes again in the world draw.
world_design.collision: Whole-foot ground support tests reject rock faces and water; only narrow bridge decks cross the river.
world_design.cow: Saved cow placements are repaired within 1100 world units of the farmhouse.

tests: camera_ground_lock_test: 56 animated pan/zoom frames on desktop/mobile render profile, real cliff samples blocked, repaired cow near home
island_journey_test: 25/25 gate, independent city progress/XP/ownership, round-trip travel, saved world state
regional_weather_test: four regional effects, neutral hub, entry animations, no old global weather rotation
seed_pointer_input_test: actual viewport pointer clicks wheat and Plant, planting queued and completed
preview_ambience_test: 3 locked season previews without save changes, actual rendered seasonal screenshots, enlarged canopy hit, butterflies, waterfall pixel change over time
paths: One winding main path and two short river spurs; circular plaza removed.
nature: Wild trees use non-uniform source atlas rows 0..310,310..620,620..1024, largest alpha component and trunk-ground anchors. Broadleaf width 280..304, pine 180..196; separate shadow and expanded canopy hitboxes. Starter pink tree appears only in Spring; Summer uses green oak. World-space fluttering butterflies visible near beds.
preview: Pulau Musim > Lihat. Read-only local render material/nature/animation, supports drag and zoom. Locked islands remain gated; no currency, unlock, saved city or active world changes.
